subject: Lake Hylia
text: An Empty Bottle is at the bottom of Lake Hylia, reached by diving down just after coming from Zora's Domain.

evidence.quote: In Lake Hylia just after coming from...bottom of the lake if you dive down.

subject: Hyrule Town
text: Collecting all ten Big Poes on Hyrule Field as Adult Link and bringing them to the guy in Hyrule Town gives an Empty Bottle.

evidence.quote: After collecting all ten of the Big Poes...on Hyrule Field as Adult Link, bring...them to the guy in Hyrule Town for this.

subject: King of the Zora
text: Bringing the Prescription from Biggoron to the King of the Zora gets Link the Eyeball Frog in return.

evidence.quote: Bring the Prescription given to you by...the Biggoron to the King of the Zora and...he'll give you this in return for it.

subject: Biggoron Sword sidequest
text: The Eyeball Frog is part of the sidequest to get the Biggoron Sword.

evidence.quote: This item is part of the sidequest...to get the Biggoron Sword, for more

subject: Forest Temple
text: The Fairy Bow is in a large treasure chest inside the Forest Temple, found after defeating some Stalfos enemies.

evidence.quote: You will find this item in a large...treasure chest inside the Forest Temple...after defeating some Stalfos enemies.

subject: Kokiri Forest
text: After completing the Deku Tree and trying to leave Kokiri Forest, Saria interrupts and gives Link the Fairy Ocarina.

evidence.quote: After completing the Deku Tree dungeon...and trying to leave Kokiri Forest, Saria...will interrupt and give it to you.

subject: Deku Tree
text: The Fairy Slingshot is obtained inside the Deku Tree early in the game and the guide says not to worry about missing it.

evidence.quote: Inside the Deku Tree, you will be...required to obtain this item early in...the game, don't worry about missing it.

subject: Fire Temple
text: After completing the Fire Temple, Link appears in the chamber where Darunia entrusts him with the Fire Medallion.

evidence.quote: After completing the Fire Temple then...afterward you will appear in the chamber...and Darunia will entrust this to Link.

subject: Zora's River
text: A fish can be caught in Zora's River using an Empty Bottle, or bought at the shop.

evidence.quote: In Zora's River for example, find one...swimming and use an Empty Bottle...Or buy at the shop.

subject: Fish
text: The most important use of the fish is to open the mouth of the monster that contains the third dungeon.

evidence.quote: The most important use for the fish is...to use to open the mouth of the...monster which contains the third dungeon.

subject: Forest Temple
text: After completing the Forest Temple, Link appears in the chamber where Saria entrusts him with the Forest Medallion.

evidence.quote: After completing the Forest Temple then...afterward you will appear in the chamber...and Saria will entrust this to Link.

subject: Shop
text: After selling all four normal masks, Link can borrow the Gerudo Mask from the shop any time he wants.

evidence.quote: After you have sold all four of the...normal masks you can then borrow this...one from the shop any time you want.

subject: Gerudo Mask
text: The Gerudo Mask has no real purpose; it mainly changes what some NPCs say to Link while he wears it.

evidence.quote: Doesn't really serve a purpose at all,...it's mostly designed to change what...some NPCs say to you while wearing it.
